records.summary: Added transaction-level XRPL metadata for the 20M raRVLN→r39TA receipt and two 20:47 r39TA→Binance-labelled rNxp4h deposits. Balance deltas show the 20M receipt was almost entirely passed onward within 31 minutes. New rNxp4h history shows many tagged customer deposits from Bitso, Uphold and Bitget, making a shared exchange deposit/omnibus function more plausible than a reserve role. Corrected RLUSD attribution: the 10M RLUSD transfer came from unlabelled rnhSfm; 'Ripple' identifies the token issuer, not the sender.
actions: Opened individual XRPL transaction details and verified ledger indices, destination tags and balance deltas.
Inspected rNxp4h's recent deposit history from multiple labelled exchanges.
Inspected rnhSfm's account profile to disambiguate the RLUSD token issuer from the transaction sender.
Preserved the prior snapshot and added immutable source/limitation shards plus a follow-up snapshot and graph on the research branch only.
blockers: rNxp4h internal exchange role and PoR membership remain unknown.
No sale, reserve replenishment, OTC settlement or collateral posting is established.
next_actions: Use Binance's official PoR export to test rNxp4h membership and distinguish deposit wallet from reserve.
Resolve raRVLN AMM/vault/loan-broker objects and any actual collateral posting.
Continue monitoring the attacker receiver separately from ordinary Binance deposits.
Do not admit the account-flow sequence as a predictive feature.
